proposals.before: Book of Sui, 77th year of Volume, 42th year of Biography
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English mistranslates 卷七十七 / 列傳第四十二 as ordinal years instead of volume and biography numbers.

proposals.before: Early in the Kaihuang reign, Prince Xia of Qin recommended him; he placed at the top of the policy examination and was ordered to join the Confucian scholars in fixing rites and music, receiving appointment as Collator.
proposals.after: Early in the Kaihuang reign, Prince Xiao of Qin recommended him; he placed at the top of the policy examination and was ordered to join the Confucian scholars in fixing rites and music, receiving appointment as Collator.
proposals.reason: 秦孝王 is Prince Xiao (Filial) of Qin; "Xia" misreads 孝.

proposals.before: During the Taikang period of Chen he answered a summons and stayed for a time at the Zhizhen Abbey.
proposals.after: During the Taijian period of Chen he answered a summons and stayed for a time at the Zhizhen Abbey.
proposals.reason: 陳太建 is the Taijian era of Chen (569–582), not Taikang.

proposals.before: During the Taikang era of Chen, summoned, he came to rest at the Zhizhen Abbey.
proposals.after: During the Taijian era of Chen, summoned, he came to rest at the Zhizhen Abbey.
proposals.reason: Literal field likewise misrenders 太建 as Taikang.

proposals.before: Yet Shiqian, hearing praise, was not pleased; Wenbi, seeing injury, was not angry; Ze's aim lay in deep obscurity—none could draw him near or push him away, none could make him noble or base—all were men who embraced simplicity.
proposals.after: Yet Shiqian, hearing praise, was not pleased; Wenxu, seeing injury, was not angry; Ze's aim lay in deep obscurity—none could draw him near or push him away, none could make him noble or base—all were men who embraced simplicity.
proposals.reason: Chinese 文詡 is Wenxu (詡 = xǔ); English Wenbi is a wrong romanization of the same person reference.

decisions.reason: s0001 is 隋書卷七十七列傳第四十二: 卷七十七 and 列傳第四十二 are volume and biography numbers, not years. Volume 77, Biography 42 matches the Chinese and the existing literal.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 隋書卷七十七列傳第四十二

decisions.reason: s0105 has 秦孝王; 孝 is Xiao (filial), so Prince Xiao of Qin is required. Xia misreads that character.
s0175 dates the episode to 陳太建時; 太建 is the Chen era Taijian, not Taikang. The proposed idiomatic fix restores the correct era name.
The literal likewise misrenders 太建 in 陳太建時 as Taikang; Taijian is the correct reading of that Chen era name.
s0253 names 文詡; 詡 is xǔ, so Wenxu is required. Wenbi is a wrong romanization of the same person.
The literal likewise misromanizes 文詡 as Wenbi; Wenxu restores the correct reading of 詡.

claimRetractions.reason: The title Prince Xia of Qin was created only by misreading 孝 as Xia in 秦孝王; s0105 supports Prince Xiao of Qin (already recorded in c0114), not a Xia title.
